newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba gets license for glaucoma treatment.
newsitem.headline: Ciba gets license for glaucoma treatment.

text.p: Ciba-Geigy AG said its unit Ciba Vision Ophthalmics has acquired a license from Osaka-based Ueno Fine Chemicals, Ltd for the treatment of glaucoma.
The agreement calls for development and marketing of the product Rescula outside of Japan, Taiwan and South Korea.

Luzi von Bidder, president of Ciba Vision Ophthalmics Worldwide said in a statement that the license agreement "focuses on developing this medication as fast as possible for the ultimate benefit of glaucoma patients worldwide." -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
